Specification: This module defines a small collection of utility operators over integers, sequences, finite sets, and functions. It provides a generic reduction operator, a summation helper, sequence membership and removal utilities, a function range constructor, and a predicate intended to characterize when a finite functional graph forms a simple cycle over a set S. The module does not define any state variables, actions, temporal specification, fairness, or proofs; it is purely a library of state-level mathematical operators.
